resolutions.issue: Initial snapshots were serialized with a trailing newline, creating false source-change fingerprints on the next run.
resolutions.resolution: Canonical snapshot text is now stripped of serialization-only trailing newlines before hashing. A later control run reported these sources unchanged.

resolutions.issue: The Bundestag Lobbyregister renders a retrieval timestamp in page text, creating a new hash on each fetch even when the substantive entry is unchanged.
resolutions.resolution: Known volatile retrieval timestamps are normalized before hashing. FY2024 lobbying expenditure is now pinned to a historical register version; FY2025 is represented as a separate current claim ZSI-C-0025.

resolutions.issue: A mutable current Lobbyregister URL had been used for a historical FY2024 claim.
resolutions.resolution: Historical and current claims now have separate temporal records and source mappings. History is preserved rather than silently overwritten.
